landing.mission_statement: We eliminate the language barrier and accelerate the integration process of foreigners.
landing.title2: Live in Turkey on your terms.
landing.subtitle: Learn practical, survival Turkish through gamified lessons and interactive role-play — designed for Arabic, Russian, and Persian speakers navigating daily life in Turkey.
landing.features_title: Everything you need to survive — and thrive
landing.features_subtitle: Practical, bite-sized lessons designed around real situations you face every day in Turkey.
landing.how_it_works_sub: From zero to confident in just a few weeks.
landing.curriculum_sub: A1 → A1+ → A2 → A2+. Real situations, not textbook sentences.
landing.cta_final_sub: Free forever. No credit card needed. Just pick your language and go.
landing.f1_desc: Before each lesson, read a clear, concise guide with vocabulary, key phrases, and survival grammar — no textbook needed.
landing.f2_desc: Stay motivated with daily streaks, hearts, and coins. Lose a heart for mistakes, earn XP for every lesson you complete.
landing.f3_desc: Practice real-life conversations: negotiate at the market, order at a café, ask for directions — with branching RPG dialogue.
landing.f4_desc: Full interface support for English, Arabic, Russian, and Persian. All translations are shown in your native language.
landing.s1_desc: Choose your native language for translations and UI.
landing.s2_desc: Learn vocab and key phrases before each new unit.
landing.s3_desc: Drag, match, fill-in, and role-play your way to fluency.
landing.s4_desc: Handle real-life situations — market, hospital, bank.
